component.name: pot-guling
component.summary: Desktop translation, OCR and AI follow-up chat based on Pot
基于 Pot 的桌面翻译、截图识别与 AI 追问工具

description.p: A personal fork of Pot with AI follow-up chat, image questions and multiple translation windows.
Pot 的个人派生版，提供 AI 多轮追问、带图追问、多翻译窗口和设置体验改进。
Based on Pot by Pylogmon and contributors. This fork currently validates Windows x64 releases; Linux packaging is not verified.
